children: The Indian government is planning to raise 7.86 trillion rupees ($82 billion) through bond sales between October and March, marginally lower than its previously announced schedule in its effort to tame rising bond yields and ensure market stability.
India has reduced its gross borrowing for the fiscal year to 16 trillion rupees, down from 16.09 trillion rupees for the the current financial year through March.
